description: List deals from the tenant's connected Pipedrive account. `filters` is passed straight through as Pipedrive query params — common ones: status ('open'|'won'|'lost'|'deleted'), stage_id, person_id, org_id, user_id (owner). Pipedrive must be connected via Integrations first.

filters.description: Raw Pipedrive query params, e.g. {status:'open', stage_id:3}.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

name: list_pipedrive_deals
